page.layout: One block of text: a centred heading "Errata typographica." above a single column of errata entries in running paragraph form. No margin notes, no page number, no running head.

main_text.head: Errata typographica.
main_text.p: Pag. 51. lin. quodsi pro si lege sic. p. 55. lin. sola pro sola. 1 soli. ibid. lin. quod pro primum lege praemium. p. 58. l. Quid post ex lege ex ejusdem capitis s. p. 56. l. quia deleatur quia. lin. sus. pro miro l. mero p. 71. lin. lem. pro victoriam lege violentium. p. 74. lin. impiorum pro judicio lege judicia. p. 87. l. bus. post agat lege nisi quatenus. p. 94. l. psum. lege seipsam. p. 97. lin. sent omittatur vox perseverantia. p. 114. lin. cent lege aperiantur. Siqua porro alia irrepserunt, ea benevolus lector emendare dignabitur.

page.notes: Several entries are partly illegible in the scan (for example "quodsi", "sola", "quia", "lem.", "bus.", "psum."), and the page numbers are read as printed. The Greek-free text is set in roman with italic words; the italic words are marked above with <i>. Some readings, notably "Pag. 51." and "p. 55.", are uncertain.
